tips.text: Run the Void Storms solo or with a coordinated duo; public squads leave breaches unfixed.
For mastery alone any roll works; Valence Fusion can raise the bonus later.
If you want 60%, bank 40 to 80 keys and buy only a roll of 52.8% or better.
Do not buy a 25% Exec just because you have 40 keys; it commits you to more rotations.
Check the wiki's Ergo Glast page for the live roll before you spend keys.
Hold extra copies unfused until you know your ceiling; fusing a low roll into a low roll wastes a purchase.
Getting an Exec at all is one session; a 60% Exec means waiting on rotations.
Opinion on the Holokey grind is split: short runs that never fail against Railjack for its own sake.
